IdentityResolver — maps (ChannelKind, raw_channel_user_id) → UserId.

Persistence: tab-separated file, one mapping per line: telegram:12345tuuidn discord:678901234tuuidn

Link codes enable cross-channel identity linking (/mycode → /continue): User on Telegram calls /mycode → gets 6-char code, valid 10 minutes. User on Discord calls /continue <code> → their Discord ID is mapped to the same UUID as the Telegram user.
